title: Neurograf v1: An End-to-End Romanian-First Language Model Family
abstract: arXiv:2610.13134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Neurograf v1, an experimental end-to-end Romanian-first language-model pipeline developed to investigate the feasibility of training language models from scratch for a lower-resource European language. The pipeline comprises RoSfera, a 635 GB Romanian corpus containing 175.7 million documents; an 80k byte-level BPE tokenizer; five decoder-only models ranging from 160M to 6B parameters, trained on 131 billion tokens; three instruction-tuned assistants; and two contrastively trained embedding models. Training and evaluation were conducted using computing infrastructure at ELI-NP/IFIN-HH.   The model family exhibits consistent scaling of validation loss and increasing Romanian factual and cultural knowledge with model size. On the 1,000-question WWTBM benchmark, Neurograf-6B achieves 69.89% accuracy on Romanian-context questions, while Neurograf-3.2B reaches 67.38%. translated_title: Neurograf v1：一个端到端的罗马尼亚语优先语言模型家族
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Neurograf v1，这是一个实验性的端到端罗马尼亚语优先语言模型流水线，旨在研究从零开始为低资源欧洲语言训练语言模型的可行性。该流水线包括：RoSfera，一个635 GB的罗马尼亚语语料库，包含1.757亿个文档；一个8万词表规模的字节级BPE分词器；五个参数规模从1.6亿到60亿不等的仅解码器模型，在1310亿个token上训练；三个经过指令微调的助手模型；以及两个通过对比学习训练的嵌入模型。训练和评估均使用ELI-NP/IFIN-HH的计算基础设施完成。该模型家族表现出验证损失随模型规模一致缩放的趋势，且罗马尼亚语事实性和文化知识随模型规模增大而不断提升。在包含1000个问题的WWTBM基准测试中，Neurograf-6B在罗马尼亚语背景问题上达到69.89%的准确率，Neurograf-3.2B达到67.38%。计算最优分析得出了参数缩放指数为（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了Neurograf v1——首个从零开始为罗马尼亚语这一低资源欧洲语言构建的端到端语言模型家族，涵盖635 GB语料库、分词器、五个基础模型、指令微调助手和嵌入模型，验证了低资源语言从零训练大模型的可行性。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Neurograf v1, an end-to-end Romanian-first language model family trained entirely from scratch—including a 635 GB corpus, tokenizer, five base models, instruction-tuned assistants, and embedding models—demonstrating the feasibility of building LLMs from scratch for lower-resource European languages.
